programs.description: Ayyappan, a tabla player in a drama troupe, mysteriously disappears, leading CI Jacob Eeraly to uncover hidden secrets as he investigates the lives of those around him.
Susheela deserts her children and husband, Kaimal, to begin a new life with Giri. On learning this, Kaimal's friend, Balan, tries to reconcile them.
Venu, a lorry driver, tries to save the family of his late father's boss from an evil businessman. However, he ends up in a fix when he learns that the evil businessman is none other than his boss.
Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Kuruppinte Kanakku Pustakom
Heartbroken on being back-stabbed by his childhood friend, Raju, an influential man, runs away from his hometown, Kotha. Soon, to bring back order in the town, a police officer plots a plan.
Nandagopal raises his epileptic sister, Ammu, after their parents' death. He gets her married to Venu without telling him about her illness, but it comes to light soon and creates problems for them.

While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.
A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.
After Ranga Rao fixes his daughter Mahalakshmi's marriage with Dhorababu, an honest man, she reveals that she is in love with a man named Kishore. Soon, Dhorababu goes looking for Kishore.

A man proposes to his close friend on the night before her wedding. However, he incurs the wrath of her older brothers when he elopes with her.
Manjula, a transgender woman in Kerala, faces daily challenges in a conservative society. Her journey of self-acceptance and resilience unfolds against evolving social norms.
Radha and Sasikumar fall in love with each other. However, her life takes a turn when he refuses to marry her because of his family problems.
Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.
Four friends are nothing but timid, petty thieves trying to get by for a living. Things change drastically for them when they get caught in the act of stealing.
Zachariah and Balu remain best friends even after their marriage. However, things take a turn when their wives start fighting with each other.
